STEP 1 - Scene: A small salad of mixed leafy greens (looks like arugula/rocket and parsley-like herbs) with a few radish slices and small pieces of pale green vegetable (possibly avocado or cucumber). Photographed from above, roughly top-down, in a white square bowl.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The white bowl is square, about 20 cm across the top edge (comparable to a side dish/small salad bowl). Area of a 20 cm square ≈ 400 cm², and the visible interior is roughly 300-350 cm² after rim and wall allowance. Use ~330 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: mixed leafy greens (arugula, herbs), radish slices (about 3-4 pieces), small pale green pieces (avocado or cucumber, about 3-4 chunks), a few thin red pepper/radish bits.

STEP 4 - Area: Mixed leafy greens ~45% of vessel area; radish slices ~2%; pale green chunks ~4%; other bits ~1%. Total food covers ~52% of the bowl (about 170 cm²).

STEP 5 - Volume: Leafy greens 150 cm² x 3 cm = 450 ml; radish 7 cm² x 0.5 cm = 3.5 ml; pale green pieces 13 cm² x 1.5 cm = 20 ml (mostly cut vegetable, lighter pile); other bits ~2 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Leafy greens 450 ml x 0.15 = 68 g; radish 3.5 ml x 0.6 = 2 g; pale green pieces 20 ml x 0.6 = 12 g; other bits ~1 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Leafy greens 68 g x 25 kcal/100 g = 17 kcal; radish 2 g x 16 = 0.3 kcal; avocado/cucumber 12 g x 100 kcal/100 g (assuming avocado-like) = 12 kcal; other bits negligible.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A small bowl of salad greens with a few radish and vegetable pieces at roughly 80 g and ~30 kcal is plausible. Dressing is not visibly present, so none is included.

Total: about 83 g, about 30 kcal.
